label: GEMINI_L5_INVENTORY_REPLAY_V1
status: RESEARCH ONLY. Every fill is MODELLED against a captured executable ladder. NOTHING here is realized profit. No orders were placed.
sell_note: ZERO sells. L5's corpus is 9901 fills, all BUY, so end-of-window exposure reduction cannot be reproduced by selling; the sell-side fee is unreconciled in any case. Residual is carried to settlement. No result here depends on a SELL.
exclusion_note: sealed OOS outcomes are never read -- those windows are dropped before any computation
fill_model: marketable BUY only; vwap() must clear the full requested size out of cumulative captured depth at the first observation at or after decision + 0.197s, and that VWAP is the price paid. No touch=fill.

time_scaling.note: L5 timings scaled by 300/900 = 1/3 and stated as required: T+44s -> T+14.7s, 52s -> 17.3s, 2s -> one 1 Hz tick.

action_family.ACQUIRE: favored (dearer) executable side, price in L5's own first-fill band [0.20, 0.82], at or after T+14.7s
action_family.EXTEND: same side again, band-gated, budget 1 = L5's median same-side extends before complementing. NOT price-improvement gated -- L5's tape shows no such rule.
action_family.COMPRESS: buy the deficit side when all-in pair cost would land at or under the trigger. Pair cost is NOT required below 1 after leg 1.
action_family.SWITCH: implicit: COMPRESS on the opposite side is the switch, and once matched the machine re-ACQUIREs the favored side, which is how L5 keeps working inventory.
action_family.RESIDUAL: carried to settlement; no SELL exists to reduce it

l5_corpus_derivation.extend_gate_note: L5 paid a LOWER price on 3780 same-side repeats and a HIGHER price on 3366. There is no improvement-only extend rule in the tape, so none is invented here.
l5_corpus_derivation.sides_observed: BUY only (L5 never sells in this corpus)

THE_TOLERANCE_TEST_pair_cost_after_leg1.note: the lane's premise: leg 1 is NOT required to leave pair cost below $1. This is what happened to the ones that started above it.

RESIDUAL_CALIBRATION_DIAGNOSTIC.note: descriptive only. Acting on this by inverting the ACQUIRE side would be fitting a side choice to these very outcomes, so it is NOT done here.
RESIDUAL_CALIBRATION_DIAGNOSTIC.implied_vs_realized: the residual is the FAVORED side; its basis is what the book said it was worth, and the win rate is what it was actually worth
